violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Observed raw shrimp sitting in a container of water in 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC understands thawing food should be cooked from frozen, thaw under continuous running water, or put in a refrigerator to thaw. PIC completely submerged raw shrimp under running water.

violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Observed employees medicine on the kitchen shelf among food containers.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. PIC removed medicine from the counter and placed in designated area away from all food and food contact surfaces.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed a knife stored in a split of 3-compartment sink at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed, properly cleaned and stored knife on the clean prep surface.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required & Posted
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Observed no 2024 permit posted in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. PIC agreed to locate and post permit in a conspicuous location. EHS willl follow up in three days to verify compliance.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment during the time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. EHS spoke to PIC about CFM being unavailable during inspection. EHS will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: EHS observed storage containers of flour, sugar, and spices, squeeze bottles of water, white wine, and oil without labels.
